Individual Stats:
ARCHMERE: Togo 0-0-0-15-0; Skibicki 0-0-2-3-13; Schneider 4-2-0-8-0; Bowe 6-3-0-10-0.
TATNALL: Eppes 10-3-1-12-0; Spence 4-1-3-7-0; Kuhn 4-2-0-0-0; McGowan 1-0-4-2-0.
Photos by Cindy Knorr
resolvedIssues.reason: Archmere and Tatnall labels appear reversed; all individual values withheld pending correction.
resolvedIssues.explanation: Team headings are reversed: Togo, Skibicki, Schneider and Bowe are Tatnall players. The Archmere rows are Eppes (Marissa), Spence (Patreece), Kuhn (Elizabeth/Lizzy) and McGowan (Carly). Applied in kills, aces, blocks, digs, assists order, explicitly keyed in the September 18 and September 29, 2009 official summaries. The disputed page itself does not print a stat key. Original values are unchanged; only team attribution is corrected. These four published rows may not be a complete team box score.
